description: Daily maintenance task tracker for Lavender project

tasks.title: Lint+pytest (capture failures)
tasks.description: run quick lint/tests and write any failures to /tmp/lavender-failures.txt
tasks.comment: Shell: flake8 dashboard tests && python -m pytest tests/ -v

tasks.title: Add missing unit tests
tasks.description: read /tmp/lavender-failures.txt and add/adjust tests for failures

tasks.title: Update docs
tasks.description: update docs/*.md for any endpoints touched by failing tests
tasks.comment: Shell: ls docs/*.md and update relevant files

tasks.title: Add missing unit tests for uncovered modules
tasks.description: Create unit tests for dashboard modules lacking coverage

tasks.title: Update documentation for new endpoints
tasks.description: Ensure docs/api.md matches all FastAPI endpoint decorators

lint-pytest.title: Run lint + pytest, capture failures
lint-pytest.description: Execute flake8 linting and pytest, save failures to /tmp/lavender-failures.txt
lint-pytest.script: flake8 dashboard tests --count && python -m pytest tests/ -v

test-coverage.title: Add missing unit tests for failing modules
test-coverage.description: Identify modules with poor coverage and create corresponding test files

docs-update.title: Update docs for new endpoints
docs-update.description: Verify docs/api.md matches source code endpoints and add missing documentation

telegram-summary.title: Send Telegram summary after all tasks complete
telegram-summary.description: Generate and send daily maintenance report via Telegram

lint-capture-failures.title: Lint+pytest (capture failures)
lint-capture-failures.description: run quick lint/tests and write any failures to /tmp/lavender-failures.txt
lint-capture-failures.script: cd /home/rahat/lavender && flake8 dashboard tests --count --output-file=/tmp/lavender-lint-failures.txt; python -m pytest tests/ -v 2>&1 | tee /tmp/lavender-pytest-failures.txt; cat /tmp/lavender-lint-failures.txt /tmp/lavender-pytest-failures.txt > /tmp/lavender-failures.txt
lint-capture-failures.comment: Shell: flake8 dashboard tests && python -m pytest tests/ -v

add-missing-unit-tests.title: Add missing unit tests
add-missing-unit-tests.description: read /tmp/lavender-failures.txt and add/adjust tests for failures

update-docs.title: Update docs
update-docs.description: update docs/*.md for any endpoints touched by failing tests
update-docs.comment: Shell: ls docs/*.md and update relevant files
